title: JevLint-LE project settings
description: Lint settings for this project. The editor and the command line both read this file, so they report the same findings.

rules.description: The level of a rule, by its code or its name. A rule not listed keeps its default. `warn` means `warning`.

fallbackOptions.description: Words that make a Choice option a fallback, such as other or none. An option counts when one of them is a word in its name.

ignore.description: Findings to leave out, each written as a rule code, a colon and a question id: JEV004:department.

exclude.description: Files and folders not to lint, as patterns relative to this file. `**` crosses folders, `*` stays inside one, and a name with no slash matches at any depth: fixtures, **/*.generated.ts, test/data/**.
